title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Marvel's Spider-Man Superdrop

paragraphs.text: Secret Lair Drop Series: Marvel's Spider-Man is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on September 22, 2025.

This superdrop is the third Secret Lair collaboration between Hasbro ( Wizards of the Coast ) and Marvel Entertainment . It is released in connection with the Universes Beyond tentpole set Marvel's Spider-Man . The content of one drop was revealed on the Magic panel at PAX West on August 29, 2025.
As an extra, the drops come with a surprise bonus card.
